messages.text: The catalog contract is now fixed at 22 source-grounded prompts and the required model/category vocabulary; the source uses image ratios from square through landscape rather than uniform cards. I’m preparing a cohesive set of editorial prompt previews sized for those masonry slots, then I’ll bind them to persistent records and routes so every visible action corresponds to stored state.
